description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for virtual input devices, including key, mouse, and touch input types, within the WPEFramework project. It includes enum definitions, data structures for input events, and message type definitions for inter-process communication.

classes.name: LinkInfo
classes.description: Structure containing information about a virtual input link, including mode and name.

classes.name: KeyData
classes.description: Structure representing key input data, including action type and key code.

classes.name: MouseData
classes.description: Structure representing mouse input data, including action, button, and movement coordinates.

classes.name: TouchData
classes.description: Structure representing touch input data, including action, index, and position.

methods.name: enum inputtypes
methods.description: Enumeration of input device types: key, mouse, touch.

methods.name: typedef enum : uint8_t
methods.description: Enumerations for input actions within KeyData, MouseData, and TouchData structures.
